"""
Utilities that render hints on how to reproduce a CI build locally.

When Breeze runs inside GitHub Actions we can help contributors by printing the exact
set of commands they can run on their own machine to reproduce whatever the CI job did:
how to check out the same code, how to build the CI image, and how to run the very same
Breeze command that CI ran.

from __future__ import annotations

import os
import re
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from typing import TYPE_CHECKING

# Parameters that only control Breeze's own behaviour and are never useful when reproducing
# a command locally - they must never be emitted in the reproduction command line.
EXCLUDED_PARAMETERS = frozenset(

        "dry_run",
        "answer",
        "include_success_outputs",
        "debug_resources",
    }
)

# Pattern of a GITHUB_REF that points at a pull request, e.g. ``refs/pull/1234/merge``.
_PULL_REQUEST_REF_PATTERN = re.compile(r"^refs/pull/(?P<number>\d+)/(?P<kind>merge|head)$")

# Width of the horizontal rulers surrounding the rendered reproduction block.
_RULER = "─" * 80


@dataclass
class ReproductionCommand:
    """A single shell command for local reproduction.

    :param argv: the command-line tokens (e.g. ``["git", "checkout", "abc123"]``).
    :param comment: optional human-readable comment shown before the command.
    """

    argv: list[str]
    comment: str | None = None


def should_print_local_reproduction() -> bool:
    """Return ``True`` only when running inside GitHub Actions CI.

    Both the ``CI`` and ``GITHUB_ACTIONS`` environment variables must equal ``"true"``
    (compared case-insensitively). Any other value - including a missing variable - results
    in ``False``.
    """
    return (
        os.environ.get("CI", "").lower() == "true"
        and os.environ.get("GITHUB_ACTIONS", "").lower() == "true"
    )


def build_ci_image_reproduction_command(
    *,
    github_repository: str = APACHE_AIRFLOW_GITHUB_REPOSITORY,
    platform: str = "linux/amd64",
    python: str = "",
) -> ReproductionCommand:
    """Build the command that builds the CI image locally.

    The ``--github-repository`` flag is only appended when ``github_repository`` differs from
    the default Apache Airflow repository. The ``--platform`` and ``--python`` flags are always
    appended.
    """
    argv = ["breeze", "ci-image", "build"]
    if github_repository != APACHE_AIRFLOW_GITHUB_REPOSITORY:
        argv += ["--github-repository", github_repository]
    argv += ["--platform", platform]
    argv += ["--python", python]
